facts.note: Nine-o'clock temple bell, watches shown; narrator's watch exact, doctor's two minutes ahead, Girard would not take his out.
Hall clock struck ten at regulator's twelve minutes to ten; master's usual remark about that clock; regulator agreed with temple bell at ten.
Master sent her down at regulator's twenty past ten; regulator running and master well; she went straight to the kitchen.
That afternoon she saw the master in the kitchen with Rosa's clock in his hands, laughing; did not ask why.
In the kitchen she looked at Rosa's clock as the piano began (two minutes to eleven) and when it stopped (eleven minutes past eleven).
Stayed in the kitchen with Rosa until after the temple struck eleven.
